title: Iran's Araghchi Meets Qatari Mediators as US Pushes Nuclear Talks
detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Qatari mediators amid intensifying US pressure on Tehran to return to nuclear negotiations. Qatar has served as a key intermediary channel between Washington and Tehran throughout the diplomatic standoff following the IAEA Security Council referral.

media.caption: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi meets Qatari mediators amid US nuclear talks pressure

title: US Treasury Sanctions 10 Entities Supporting Iran's Military
detail: The US Treasury Department sanctioned 10 entities accused of supporting Iran's military, continuing a series of economic pressure measures targeting Iran's defense supply chain. The designations are part of Washington's ongoing maximum-pressure strategy aimed at restricting Tehran's access to components and funding for its weapons programs.

media.caption: US Treasury sanctions entities supporting Iran's military supply chain
